features: FLEXIBLE WAN CONNECTIVITY: Supports up to 4 WAN ports, enabling load balancing across multiple broadband connections for uninterrupted business operations.
PPPoE SERVER: Built-in PPPoE server allows businesses to manage and authenticate multiple user connections efficiently within the network.
ADVANCED QoS: Intelligent Quality of Service controls prioritise critical traffic, ensuring smooth performance for bandwidth-sensitive applications.
STRONG FIREWALL PROTECTION: Robust firewall features safeguard your network against unauthorised access, intrusions, and potential cyber threats.
3-YEAR WARRANTY: Backed by a 3-year warranty, this business router is built for reliable, long-term performance in demanding network environments.
description: The TL-R470T+ Load Balance Broadband Business Router is a powerful and reliable networking solution designed to meet the demanding requirements of modern businesses. Supporting up to 4 WAN ports, this router enables seamless load balancing across multiple internet connections, ensuring uninterrupted connectivity and optimal bandwidth utilisation at all times. The built-in PPPoE Server simplifies network management, making it an ideal choice for small to medium-sized enterprises. Advanced QoS (Quality of Service) features allow administrators to prioritise critical traffic, ensuring smooth performance for voice, video, and data applications. The robust firewall provides strong protection against external threats, keeping your business network secure. With its intuitive management interface and flexible configuration options, this router is well-suited for IT professionals and network administrators alike. Backed by a 3-year warranty, the TL-R470T+ offers long-term reliability and peace of mind for your business infrastructure.
